info.title: permission.proto
info.description:
Permission Service provides CRUD operations for managing access control permissions.
A permission defines a specific action that can be performed on a resource.

Permissions are the fundamental unit of access control in this system.
They are assigned to Groups, and indirectly to Roles through their parent Group.

Resource-Action Examples:
- resource: "invoices", action: "read" → permission to read invoices
- resource: "users", action: "write" → permission to modify users
- resource: "settings", action: "admin" → full administrative access
